baseline_result: Authored quadratic exact SVG export succeeds (1166 bytes). The same source restricted to the selected positive root of 2t^2-1 constructs and reverses exactly, but export returns Geometry("exact SVG metadata does not encode selected curve carriers"). The expected-success assertion fails with status101. Reversed export was not reached after this first failure.
source_attribution: Cargo built the library from the clean committed checkout; build, explicit rustc command, library/source hashes and runtime failure retained. No repository source was edited.
design_constraints_discovered: Existing HCP3 extension is per stroke path; filled regions are currently emitted only as projected SVG paths. Extending a stroke payload alone would not establish native filled-region replay.

A source table must retain shared definitions across all relevant curves/paths and parameters rather than expanding them recursively; allocation-based deduplication cannot become mathematical equality.
BezierAlgebraicParameter2 exposes source_chart() for flattened projective roots; replay must preserve and validate the original root and chart, not just copy the image polynomial and interval.
CurveParameter2 also has selected recursive scalars, chord and cusp parameters. A univariate-root restriction increment must declare those remaining gaps instead of coercing them into scalars.
The display projection path already exists for retained strokes; it must remain separate from authoritative native metadata.
next: Design a coherent versioned shared-definition envelope and then reproduce the concrete acceptance witnesses on the next committed target. No serialization implementation change has started.

additional_read_only_review.scalar_serialization: The inspected Hyperreal public scalar codec exposes per-value to_bytes/from_bytes and validates RealWire on import. No public shared multi-value encoder was found in this source review. A geometry archive must assess shared scalar dependencies and avoid assuming that repeated per-coordinate serialization preserves a compact construction graph. This is an implementation-design observation, not a reproduced scalar-codec defect.
additional_read_only_review.region_replay: CurveRegion2::boundary_paths exposes exact retained paths for reconstruction; this does not by itself supply serialized source/parameter graph definitions. PolynomialCurveSet2::from_topology consumes a solver-certified private graph and replays point selectors, so native replay must obtain valid topology authority rather than deserialize trusted graph flags.
additional_read_only_review.parameter_charts: BezierAlgebraicParameter2::source_chart and projective_image expose the original root and chart for proof-preserving replay; CurveParameter2 additionally owns selected-fiber and recursive parameters that must remain explicit.
